correctness.rationale: Direct facet-normal signs for square and triangular faces show six silhouette edges when a<b+c and eight when a>b+c. Cauchy projected-area formula gives 3(a+b+c) and 4a+2b+2c in those respective chambers. Spherical triangle Girard area yields p=12 atan(3-2sqrt2)/pi. Independent high-precision evaluation yielded p=0.649040687816, conditional areas 4.62220636751<4.93518977112, covariance -0.142587021853. The analytical surface-divergence boundary flux integral of B over one spherical triangle is pi/2, yielding exact weighted mass 3 and complementary sqrt3; the finite Monte Carlo checker cannot replace that proof.
